extracted.name: Strawberry & Blueberry Waffles
extracted.description: Great recipe for Strawberry & Blueberry Waffles.
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, whisk together the dry ingredients. In a smaller bowl, whisk the eggs, melted butter, milk and vanilla until well combined.
Mix both dry and wet ingredients. The mixture will be lumpy. Fold in the blueberries and strawberries.
Spray the waffle iron with baking spray, and cook waffles until light brown and slightly crispy. Add your favorite toppings and enjoy!!
